text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, August 21, 2022, Appeal DDRT2023-04.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog and directed that the conditions of the Order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Paisley Anne Wong-Nabua and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before May 5, 2023.
